study type: National cohort and nested case-control study
exposure: Previous postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) requiring treatment or transfusion
Caesarean section associated with previous PPH
outcome: PPH requiring transfer to obstetric care
Transfer to obstetric care for any reason
cohort: Multiparous women admitted for labor care to alongside midwifery units (AMUs) in the UK between August 2018 and April 2019
finding: Multiparous women with a previous PPH had a significantly higher risk of experiencing a subsequent PPH requiring transfer to obstetric care compared to multiparous women without a previous PPH.
gest_age: Mentioned as a risk factor but not specified
birth_weight: Mentioned as a risk factor but not specified
